title: Finite Smith–Toda complexes at every height

result.label: Finite Smith–Toda complexes at every height
result.statement: For every n ≥ 0, constructs a finite Smith–Toda spectrum at a prime p depending on n , with Brown–Peterson homology BP/(p,v1, ,vn) and the canonical comodule structure. Thus Smith–Toda complexes exist at every height when the prime may vary; an explicit example realizes V(4) at p = 1009.
